name: compact-adviser-openrouter
description: Suggests /compact at a completed checkpoint, judged by TypeSafe Jev through OpenRouter. Plain command hooks; needs Node 22.18+ and an OpenRouter API key.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: hint shows advice after a finished turn; off disables the adviser.

minContextTokens.title: Minimum context (tokens)
minContextTokens.description: No judgment below this context size.

contextLimitTokens.title: Context limit (tokens)
contextLimitTokens.description: Where Claude Code auto-compacts for your model; the hint floor relaxes as context approaches it.

model.title: OpenRouter model
model.description: The OpenRouter model id that judges checkpoints.

logRequests.title: Log requests
logRequests.description: Append each request and sanitized outcome to ~/.claude/compact-adviser/requests-<session>.jsonl. Never logs the key.

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterApiKey.description: A non-empty OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment wins.
